blocks.raw: # Configure Validity and Renewal Conditions
blocks.text: Configure Validity and Renewal Conditions

blocks.raw: # Validity period
blocks.text: Validity period

blocks.raw: The validity period indicates how long a customer can access the benefits of their respective tier.
blocks.text: The validity period indicates how long a customer can access the benefits of their respective tier.

blocks.raw: The validity of the tier can be validated by one of the following options:
blocks.text: The validity of the tier can be validated by one of the following options:

blocks.raw:
* Until tier upgrade or fixed duration
* Until next registration date of customer
* Until fixed date
blocks.text: Until tier upgrade or fixed durationUntil next registration date of customerUntil fixed date

blocks.raw: ## Until tier upgrade or fixed duration
blocks.text: Until tier upgrade or fixed duration

blocks.raw: The validity of the tier is validated after a specific fixed duration period. During this time, customers have the opportunity to upgrade to a higher tier and then the validity period of the customer is adjusted to align with their upgraded tier.
blocks.text: The validity of the tier is validated after a specific fixed duration period. During this time, customers have the opportunity to upgrade to a higher tier and then the validity period of the customer is adjusted to align with their upgraded tier.

blocks.raw: The system calculates the tier expiry date as the new cycle start date plus the cycle window (for example, 12 or 24 months), minus one second. This means the tier remains valid up to the last moment before the same time on the corresponding date after the cycle window. The calculation uses the event or bill date, not the checkout time, to determine the start of the new cycle.

blocks.raw: ## Until the next registration date of customer

blocks.raw: The registration date refers to the date when a customer registers as a loyalty customer. In this scenario, the program annually validates the validity of the tier based on the registration date of the customer.
